sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select kind,client,detail,owner from v_attention order by kind,client

sections.title: Jobs due soon
sections.sql: select name as job,client,state,due_on,days_to_due,manager,requests_open,missing from v_jobs where open and due_on<=current_date+setting('job_due_days')::integer order by due_on

sections.title: Waiting on clients
sections.sql: select client,item,job,due_on,days_overdue,chases,last_chased_on from v_requests where status='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Out for signature
sections.sql: select client,title,signer,sent_on,days_out from v_signatures where signed_on is null order by sent_on

sections.title: Open jobs by state
sections.sql: select state,name as job,client,due_on,days_to_due,manager,missing from v_jobs where open order by array_position(array['planned','in_progress','awaiting_client','review','signing'],state),due_on

sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: select reviewer,client,title,submitted_on,current_date-submitted_on as days_waiting from v_documents where status='review' order by submitted_on

sections.title: Finished jobs missing a required document
sections.sql: select j.name as job,j.client,k.category from v_jobs j join v_checklist k on k.job_id=j.id where not j.open and k.final=0 order by j.name

sections.title: Past retention and not on hold
sections.sql: select client,country,category,title,retain_until,days_past from v_retention order by retain_until

sections.title: On hold
sections.sql: select name as client,hold_reason as reason from clients where hold order by name

sections.title: Inbox not filed
sections.sql: select title,email_from as sender,filed_on from v_documents where client_id is null and status<>'disposed' order by filed_on

sections.title: Identity and engagement
sections.sql: select name as client,aml_risk,id_verified_on,(select string_agg(service||' to '||review_on,', ') from engagements e where e.client_id=c.id and not e.superseded) as engagement_terms from clients c where active order by id_verified_on nulls first
